snippet.title: Ninety Nine Dungeons - game trailer, 2026 summer
snippet.description:
Steam Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4469500/Ninety_Nine_Dungeons/

Ninety Nine Dungeons — A high-quality roguelite dungeon adventure game.

Choose your starting class and step into a dungeon filled with magic and dragons. Defeat powerful bosses on procedurally generated maps, uncover hidden treasures, and build unique, powerful builds. Whether you enjoy instantly obliterating enemies or dominating the battlefield, you can push all the way to the 99th floor of the ever-changing dungeon!

Every floor is packed with deadly traps, mighty guardians, and unexpected random events. Use power, skill, and strategy to equip and optimize your own unique playstyle. Challenge your limits and create your own legendary adventure story!

This is my solo-developed indie game. Although I’m still polishing and improving it, I truly believe it will become a high-quality roguelite that you’ll love replaying again and again.

Add the game to your Steam Wishlist.

#indiegame #roguelite #solodev
